"Perfect nahi, progress pe focus karo."
Jis person banna chahte, usi tarah act start karo.
"Jo kabhi nahi mila, woh chahiye? jo kabhi nahi kiya, woh karo."
Power tab aati jab tum act choose karte.
"Success final nahi; failure fatal nahi—bas courage to continue."
Kal ko realize karne ka ek hi limit hai—aj ke doubts.
Apne darr se mat dabo.
"Tum goals pe nahi—tum system pe rise/ fall karte."
"Perseverance long race nahi—many short races continuous."
Mindset, talent se zyada matter karta hai.
"Tumhari thoughts reality banati."
Din count nahi, din ko meaningful banao.
